## Meet the data

### The story

`r lab$info$story`

### The responses

The data are **`r lab$info$data_title`**: `r nrow(resp)` people answered
`r ncol(resp)` items. `r if (lab$polytomous) "The items are scored in ordered categories (0, 1, 2 and so on)." else "Each item is scored 1 (right) or 0 (wrong)."`
`r if (!is.null(group)) paste0("Each person also belongs to one of two groups (", paste(levels(group), collapse = " or "), "), which you will use to check whether the items are fair.") else ""`

The scored responses are in `resp`, one column per item and one row per
person. Run the code to look at the first rows and the size of the data.

```{r {{id}}-look, exercise = TRUE}
head(resp)
dim(resp)
```

```{r {{id}}-look-check}
"Each row is a person and each column is an item."
```
